items.title: Octave Crosby Interview
items.q: And I also played with Luis DuMaine out at the Bungalow. That was out at the West End too. Meet Luis DuMaine and a fella by the name of, I can't think of his name. Anyway, the boy no name Wilkin playing drum, and Tom Parker playing saxophone, and a fella called Gabriel, played banjo.

ctx.x: Chinese used to play with Papa Celestein years ago. Yeah, his name is Foster, don't you? Yeah, Oral Foster. What's his first name? I never did know nothing but Chinese.
